entities.title: ignore_case search misses non-ASCII case variants
entities.summary: With the ignore_case argument, the prefilter drops files whose only match differs from the pattern in the case of a non-ASCII letter.
entities.expected: search with pattern ÉCOLE and ignore_case true lists a file containing école, because the .NET regex with IgnoreCase matches it.
entities.observed: RegexLiterals.Required is not told about ignore_case, so it keeps the non-ASCII characters in the literal run (it splits runs at non-ASCII characters only for literal=true or a pattern containing "(?"); the Bloom filter folds ASCII only, so the trigrams of É never match those of é and the file is not a candidate.
reproduction: Build a Bloom filter for the text "une école ici" with Bloom.Build.
Bloom.MayContainAll returns false, while Regex.IsMatch with RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | CultureInvariant returns true.
acceptanceCriteria: test_prefilter_is_sound (or a new test) covers ignore_case with a required non-ASCII letter whose case differs, and passes.

origin.description: Found while documenting the folder: read in RegexLiterals.Required and SearchTool.Run, and reproduced with the steps above against the built library (not through the tool).
